sources.title: Solar Open — FuriosaAI Developer Center 2026.3.0 documentation
sources.snippet: Furiosa-LLM runs Solar Open in NVFP4A16 (NVFP4 weights with 16-bit activations and KV cache). FuriosaAI publishes pre-compiled NVFP4A16 builds under the furiosa-ai organization on the Hugging Face Hub, each shipping a Furiosa Executable Bundle (FXB) for running it on FuriosaAI RNGD with Furiosa-LLM.

sources.title: Solar-Open-100B-NVFP4A16 — VRAM, Quants & GPU Compatibility
sources.snippet: Solar-Open-100B-NVFP4A16 is furiosa-ai's take on the Solar-Open family: a roughly hundred-billion-parameter open-weight model packaged, as the name signals, in the NVFP4A16 format — a 4-bit weight / 16-bit activation scheme aimed at squeezing a large model onto hardware that would otherwise choke on it.
